issues.description: The problem statement UML defines numberOfLecturers as int, but the solution implementation declares numberOfLecturers as byte and uses byte in the constructor and setter. This type inconsistency between the specification (UML) and the solution can confuse students about the intended data type and may cause mismatches when they implement the class according to the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfLecturers consistent with the UML/specification by changing the solution implementation (and any related constructor parameter and setter) to use int instead of byte. Alternatively, if byte is intended, update the problem statement UML and description to specify byte for numberOfLecturers so all artifacts agree.
